text:
Marta (CSM): Aureon Health asked for a one-day enablement sprint next Thursday: morning infra workshop, midday product demo for PMs, and late-afternoon office hours. They like clear success metrics for renewal. Can we staff and confirm prereqs?

Omar (CS Ops): I can send invites and map timezones. Which timezone is primary?

Priyanka (Aureon Health): Most of our team is PST with two folks in IST. Morning PST works best: Thu 09:30-12:00 workshop, 12:30-13:30 PM demo, 15:30-16:30 office hours.

Diego (Trainer): I can run the workshop. Proposed prereqs: 10m pre-record, sandbox creds for pairs, and a short perf baseline survey. Draft agenda: intro (10m), infra deep-dive (25m), paired lab (60m), perf & security (25m).

Nina (Eng): I'll provision the sandbox with "aureon-sample-v1" and pin model `redwood-lite-3`. No SSH; web containers only. ETA Wed EOD.

Marta (CSM): Headcounts: workshop=6 infra, PM demo=4, office hours=3-5. Add metrics: baseline median latency, token cost, and 95th pct latency. We'll capture post-session numbers.

Diego (Trainer): Ok adding a 15m perf dashboard walkthrough and a 10m KMS/security note.

Omar (CS Ops): Sending tentative invites now; will confirm after sandbox ready. Subject: "Aureon Health: Enablement sprint (Thu)". Recording on.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Aureon Health Enablement: Workshop" Thu 09:30-12:00 PST guests: 6 (tentative). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/aureon234

Nina (Eng): Sandbox provisioned. Temp creds DM'd to Priyanka. Endpoint: https://sandbox.aureon.redwood; token template: aureon_user_{n}.

Priyanka (Aureon Health): Got creds, shared with team. Please include recording for IST colleagues.

Marta (CSM): I'll draft the post-session playbook and metric capture sheet for renewal pack. Anything else?

Diego (Trainer): I'll include lab reset instructions and a short troubleshooting table. See you Thursday. :rocket:

Omar (CS Ops): Invites updated to "confirmed". Closing loop.

Priyanka (Aureon Health): Thanks everyone! Looking forward.
